Lemma
[Orthonormal Bases Adapted to a Nondegenerate Flag]

↗ lem:completion-nondegenerate-bases ↗ prop:gram-schmidt-algorithm-scalar-products

If $(V,q)$ has dimension $n$ and $(v_1,\ldots ,v_k)$ is a nondegenerate tuple with $k\le n$, then $V$ has an orthonormal basis $(b_1,\ldots ,b_n)$ satisfying \[ \operatorname {span}(b_1,\ldots ,b_j)=\operatorname {span}(v_1,\ldots ,v_j),\qquad j\le k. \]
Proof

↗ lem:completion-nondegenerate-bases ↗ prop:gram-schmidt-algorithm-scalar-products \sketch Extend the tuple to a nondegenerate basis by Lemma 4, then apply Proposition 4, whose orthonormalization preserves the complete span flag.

□
